lead.hed: Navy and Marines put long-range fires in Norway for Arctic drills
lead.insight: USNI News, Thursday: sailors and Marines deployed the Navy’s containerized long-range launcher and Strike Master coastal-defense system to Norway for Operation Atlantic City 26 and NATO’s Arctic Sentry. The systems are meant to prove expeditionary fires in the High North.
lead.image_credit: U.S. Marine Corps photo by Sgt. Noah Masog · DVIDS 9899710 · Public domain · Radio operator sets communications gear on Jan Mayen during Atlantic City 26, Aug. 30, 2026.

political.hed: Defense News: NATO allies stop a Russian undersea-cable exercise
political.insight: Defense News, Thursday: Britain, Norway, and the United States tracked GUGI vessels near Svalbard this spring as they simulated a covert strike on undersea cables. No cable was cut. Norway’s defense minister said the intercept was meant to show Russia cannot operate unseen.

political.hed: SOUTHCOM: three killed in a Caribbean strike on an alleged drug boat
political.insight: USNI News, Thursday: Joint Task Force Western Hemisphere struck a go-fast in the Caribbean late Wednesday, killing three, SOUTHCOM said. The service report calls it the first such strike in September, as Marines and sailors have also been hitting floating refuelers.

political.hed: Heritage: 25 years after 9/11, reform immigration and end perpetual wars
political.insight: Heritage Foundation, Thursday: the commentary marks the 25th anniversary of Sept. 11 and argues the country still needs immigration enforcement and an end to open-ended wars. Opinion essay, not a new statute.

tech.hed: Defense News: Iran likely to reverse-engineer a captured U.S. underwater drone
tech.insight: Defense News, Thursday: CENTCOM said an older Anduril Dive-LD went dead in the water and was recovered by Iran. Analysts expect Tehran to copy the hardware; software has built-in defenses. CENTCOM called it a defective older model without classified sonar.

tech.hed: Defense News: Echodyne weighs European radar plants as drone demand rises
tech.insight: Defense News, Thursday: the U.S. radar maker is considering European production as governments scramble for counter-drone sensors. Company talk, not a signed factory deal.

culture.hed: WORLD: The Uprising wants Braveheart and cannot hold the tone
culture.insight: WORLD News Group, Thursday: the R-rated historical epic starring Andrew Garfield as “the Ploughman” in a Peasants’ Revolt story has sincere faith and grit, then turns comic-book and morally muddled. Review, not a box-office print.

culture.hed: Law & Liberty: a Nobel economist forgets how markets work
culture.insight: Law & Liberty, Thursday: John O. McGinnis reviews Daron Acemoglu’s new book and says the solutions drop public-choice limits while calling for a pro-worker AI agency. Book review, not a vote.
